slot_scores.name: missing_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to minimize the total cost of the tables ordered, or is there a different objective (such as maximizing the number of tables within a budget or meeting a specific supplier mix)?
slot_scores.rationale: Agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective before READY_TO_MODEL.

slot_scores.name: A_requires_min_B_tables
slot_scores.rationale: Agent asked only about per-supplier minimum/maximum order limits (turn 2); it never asked about the conditional link requiring a minimum of 30 B tables if A is used.

slot_scores.name: B_requires_C_order
slot_scores.rationale: Agent never asked whether ordering from Supplier B forces an order from Supplier C; the turn 2 question about per-supplier limits does not cover this conditional dependency.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no linkage between Supplier A and Supplier B; each supplier's order can be chosen independently.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the A-to-B conditional minimum-tables rule, yet its confirmed-understanding section states only non-negativity limits exist and claims all formulation-critical facts were confirmed.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Orders from Supplier B and Supplier C are independent, with no obligation to order from C when ordering from B.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the B-to-C conditional requirement and treated B and C as freely independent in its final formulation summary.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while two P1 hidden slots (A-requires-B and B-requires-C conditional rules) remained unasked and unconfirmed, resulting in a model that omits key business constraints.

summary: The agent correctly recovered the objective (H1) with a direct question but never probed the two conditional supplier-linkage rules (H2, H3), declaring all formulation-critical facts confirmed and stopping prematurely with unresolved P1 slots.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
